name: final
philosophy: Havelock-first shape. It is forced by three verified facts: (1) the last Sunday nonstop leaves 13:35 and the budget makes the Rs 9,206 Akasa 10:35 the only sane return, so Sunday must be empty; (2) Baratang needs a full Port-Blair day ending ~15:00, and Munda Pahad's trek gate shuts at 15:00, so both anchor to Fri/Sat; (3) Bharatpur watersports need the 14:32 Thursday high tide and Natural Bridge needs the 08:51 Friday low. Sleep averages 7.3 h/night (min 5.75). Cost ~Rs 40,400/person - the user's worst-case line - with listed swaps down to ~Rs 37k. v2 additions on user request: the 03:30 Thu kayak is scheduled in the trip's only true-dark window (moonset 02:54, dawn 04:47) as a confirm-by-phone attempt, and the Elephant Beach forest trek + coral-garden snorkel fills Thursday morning, pushing the Neil ferry to the verified 15:00 Nautika and the jet ski to 16:35 (beach open to 18:00). v5: snorkelling and scuba both moved to Govind Nagar on the user's call - the homestay is 50 m from that beach, which deletes the Elephant Beach trek, its speedboat fare and roughly two hours of travel. Jet ski stays at Bharatpur. v8: trimmed to the user's hard Rs 40,000/person ceiling. Flights are Rs 19,927 pp and immovable, so the ground budget had to fit Rs 20,073 pp. The kayak was the casualty - full-moon week made it a mild-glow gamble at Rs 3,500 a head - and Kala Pathar sunrise inherits the morning.
risks: September is peak monsoon (388 mm avg): every ferry/boat can be weather-delayed - all bookings chosen refundable where possible (Green Ocean/Makruzz tickets are not; budget assumes they sail)
Ferry prices/times captured live 2026-08-19; rebook-check all four sailings when booking
Bhuma homestay is cash-only and non-refundable (Rs 5,000 damage deposit)
Govind Nagar scuba price (Rs 3,500 pp shore Try Dive, Dive Andaman) and the snorkel gear rate are being re-confirmed live - treat Thursday's water costs as provisional
VERIFIED: private ferries sail from HADDO JETTY (Gate 3), not Phoenix Bay — the plan now sends you to Haddo, but confirm the gate printed on your own ticket
Late September is the tail of the SW monsoon: ferries run, but boat-based watersports at Bharatpur are weather-dependent on the day
Saturday's Cellular Jail show is Hindi-only (English runs Mon/Wed/Fri)
Bhuma's Rs 5,685 room and Pibo's Rs 5,250 rate each show only 1 left as of 20 Aug — book the rooms before the flights
Bhuma is non-refundable and cash-only; Pibo and Blue Lagoon both allow free cancellation (24 Sep and 17 Sep respectively)
Friday's Green Ocean sailing lands 12:45, leaving a 35-minute margin on the 15:00 Munda Pahad gate - if the ferry runs late, skip the trek and go straight to Chidiya Tapu for sunset

KAYAK — VERIFIED, AND DROPPING IT WAS RIGHT: operators sell bioluminescence as a NO-MOON product. Thrillophilia states it runs only '5 days before, on, and 5 days after the no-moon night'; 23-24 Sep is ~13 days after the 11 Sep new moon, i.e. outside that window. The Dive Master Havelock says a half moon already cuts the glow to 30-40%. Operators will still take the booking and paddle you out at 03:30 — the mangroves and sunrise are real — but almost none claim you would see meaningful glow in a full-moon week.

KAYAK PRICING — Andaman Bliss's Rs 3,500 pp is at the expensive end. The Dive Master Havelock (local, WhatsApp +91 70872 88214) lists Rs 2,000 pp for the same 03:30-06:00 slot: Rs 6,000 for three, not Rs 10,500. The 'Rs 2,800' Go2Andaman figure is a DAYTIME floor price, not a night quote.
KAYAK ALTERNATIVE if the crew still wants to paddle: a daytime or sunrise mangrove kayak runs about Rs 1,999-2,500 pp, is genuinely good in late September, and does not depend on the moon at all.

days.title: WHEELS UP → SWARAJ DWEEP
days.theme: Chennai dawn flight, the fast catamaran to Swaraj Dweep, then a full afternoon at the quiet end of Asia's most-photographed beach.

events.title: Wake up & roll out (Chennai)
events.notes: Bags packed the night before. Keep each check-in bag at or under 15 kg (Akasa's free allowance; the Nautika ferry caps luggage at 15 kg too).
events.tips: Carry printed ferry tickets and DL photocopies for the scooter rentals.

events.title: Ride to Chennai Airport T1
events.notes: Own cab or Uber, roughly Rs 700 and outside the trip budget.

events.title: Check-in & security (Akasa)
events.notes: Akasa's domestic counters typically close 45-60 minutes before departure - confirm the exact cut-off on akasaair.com. Being at the desk by 05:15 clears any version of it.
events.tips: Web check-in the night before to skip the queue.

events.title: FLY — Akasa QP 1145 to Port Blair
events.cost_note: 3 x Rs 10,721 (Cleartrip 3-adult search, 19 Aug)
events.notes: Boeing 737 MAX 8, 2h15m over the Bay of Bengal. Left-side windows get the island approach.

events.title: Land IXZ — bags & exit
events.notes: Tight-ish turnaround today: the ferry check-in closes at 11:45, so move briskly.

events.title: Cab to Junglighat
events.cost_note: airport taxi, ESTIMATE — no published tariff verified; carry Rs 500
events.notes: Icy Spicy sits about 3 minutes from the airport on the Junglighat side.

events.title: Quick veg lunch @ Icy Spicy
events.cost_note: ghee dosa Rs 149, mains Rs 250-350 (menu prices, 19 Aug)
events.notes: Port Blair's veg anchor, 4.2 stars from 3,491 reviews. Order dosas - they arrive fastest.
events.tips: Ask for the bill when the food lands; the ferry counter closes at 11:45.

events.title: Cab to the ferry jetty
events.cost_note: short auto/taxi hop, ESTIMATE — no verified tariff
events.tips: Go to HADDO JETTY, Gate 3 — NOT Phoenix Bay. Phoenix Bay is the government ferry terminal about 1 km away. Makruzz's own FAQ and Green Ocean's e-tickets both say Haddo.

events.title: Nautika check-in
events.notes: Reporting is 60 minutes before departure (Nautika asks 45). Check-in shuts 15 min prior and boarding 10 min prior. A printed ticket and photo ID are mandatory.
events.tips: Luggage is capped at 15 kg per person, with excess at Rs 100/kg.

events.title: SAIL — Nautika-Pro to Havelock
events.cost_note: 3 x Rs 1,800 Luxury (live operator search, 19 Aug)
events.notes: Chosen over the cheaper 13:15 Green Ocean because arriving 14:00 instead of 15:30 is what makes Neil's Cove and the Radhanagar sunset both possible today.
events.tips: Take a motion-sickness tablet 30 minutes before if the sea looks up.

events.title: Scooters at the jetty, ride out
events.cost_note: 2 x Rs 500/24h (Go2Andaman off-season rate, valid to 30 Sep)
events.notes: Booked at least 48 h ahead with DL copies; two helmets included, fuel is not.
events.tips: Photograph both scooters at handover.

events.title: Check in @ Bhuma Homestay
events.cost_note: Family Room 23 m² (1 full + 1 king + 1 sofa bed), breakfast incl., CASH only — live Booking.com quote 20 Aug for these exact nights
events.notes: 9.5/10 from 226 reviews, 50 m from Govind Nagar Beach. Rs 5,000 refundable damage deposit.
events.tips: Book this one early: only 1 of these rooms left and it is non-refundable. The larger Family Double (33 m², a third proper bed and a kitchenette) is Rs 6,920 with 3 left if this one goes.

events.title: Ride to Radhanagar (fuel en route)
events.cost_note: ~2 L petrol Rs 200 at Rs 88.66/L + parking Rs 30
events.notes: Fill both tanks at the IndianOil pump on the way — Havelock effectively has one working pump.
events.tips: Scooter parking at the beach entrance runs Rs 20-30.

events.title: Walk to Neil's Cove
events.notes: About 1.2 km along the sand to the right of the main beach.
events.tips: Barefoot is fine on sand; carry water.

events.title: Neil's Cove — the quiet lagoon
events.notes: The crowd stays behind at the main beach. Swim, float, and have the water largely to yourselves.
events.tips: Exact position is approximate — there is no Google Maps listing for the cove; just keep the sea on your left walking north-west.

events.title: SUNSET @ Radhanagar Beach
events.notes: Sunset is 17:15 (verified). Radhanagar holds Blue Flag certification; the beach is patrolled and has changing rooms.
events.tips: Stay for the afterglow — the sky keeps working for about 20 minutes after the sun goes.

events.title: Night ride back to Govind Nagar
events.notes: Dark by about 17:36. Easy pace and watch for oncoming high beams.

events.title: Dinner @ Something Different
events.cost_note: veg mains Rs 195-345 (TripAdvisor menu)
events.notes: Beachside cafe rated 4.4 from 5,224 reviews, a short hop from Bhuma.

events.title: Market stroll & wind down
events.tips: Call Andaman Bliss tonight to confirm the 03:30 kayak. Full-moon week means they may decline — if so, sleep through to 05:30 and take Kala Pathar at dawn instead.

days.title: GLOW RUN → GOVIND NAGAR REEF → NEIL
days.theme: Night kayak in the only dark window, driftwood dawn at Kala Pathar, then scuba and snorkel straight off the beach the homestay sits on - and jet ski at Bharatpur before the Neil sunset.

events.title: Up in the dark
events.notes: A gentler start than the kayak version — 6h45m of sleep behind you.
events.tips: Headlamp and a warm layer; it is properly dark until about 04:47.

events.title: Ride to Kala Pathar
events.notes: Sunrise is 05:09, so this puts you on the sand with minutes to spare.

events.title: SUNRISE @ Kala Pathar Beach
events.notes: Sunrise 05:09 over the driftwood-and-black-rock shoreline the reference video calls the best sunrise in the Andamans. With the kayak dropped this becomes the morning's centrepiece and you get a full 90 minutes of it instead of a rushed 40.
events.tips: Free roadside parking. Walk south along the sand for the empty unnamed stretches.

events.title: Breakfast @ Bhuma (included)
events.tips: Ask the night before for an early serving - you are in the water by 08:00.

events.title: Walk to the dive shop
events.notes: Bhuma sits about 50 m off Govind Nagar Beach, so this is a walk, not a ride - no scooter, no parking, no jetty queue.

events.title: SCUBA — shore dive at Govind Nagar
events.cost_note: 3 x Rs 3,500 shore Try Dive (Dive Andaman, Govind Nagar) — the shorter beginner tier
events.notes: Briefing, kit-up and a guided shore dive on the reef the reference video rates as Havelock's best. The Try Dive is the shorter option: about 30 minutes underwater against the Rs 4,500 Discover Scuba. Same reef, same instructor ratio.
events.tips: Book by phone a day ahead. No alcohol the night before; no flying for 18-24 h after — Sunday's 10:35 flight is clear. Upgrade to the Rs 4,500 Discover Scuba on the day if the budget feels comfortable when you get there.

events.title: Beach time at Govind Nagar
events.notes: Swim and dry off on the same beach after the dive. Snorkelling was dropped on your call — the scuba covers that reef, and the dive itself is time spent looking at it.
events.tips: If anyone still fancies a mask, the dive shop will usually lend gear cheaply — ask when you book the dive.

events.title: Shower, pack & checkout
events.notes: Settle the cash bill and collect the Rs 5,000 damage deposit.

events.title: Lunch @ Something Different
events.cost_note: keep it to mains — salads and sides here run Rs 195-345 each
events.notes: Beachside cafe rated 4.4 from 5,224 reviews, a short hop up the strip.

events.title: Ride to the jetty, return scooters
events.cost_note: returned inside the 24h window — no second-slot charge
events.tips: Return by the 10am rental boundary to avoid a second day's charge.

events.title: Nautika check-in
events.notes: Nautika asks you to reach 45 minutes before departure; boarding shuts 15 minutes prior.

events.title: Jetty wait
events.tips: Last reliable wifi and a proper toilet before Neil.

events.title: SAIL — Nautika-Pro to Neil
events.cost_note: 3 x Rs 1,600 Luxury (live operator search, 19 Aug)

events.title: Neil scooters at the jetty
events.cost_note: 2 x ~Rs 500/day
events.notes: Neil On Wheels, Neil Kendra (5.0-rated), ph +91 94742 68205 - book ahead.

events.title: Ride to Bharatpur
events.notes: Bharatpur is barely a kilometre from the jetty - the closest beach on the island.

events.title: JET SKI @ Bharatpur
events.cost_note: 3 x Rs 700 (walk-up counter rate Rs 500-700 for a ~10-min ride)
events.notes: Gliding over the lagoon your notes and the video both rate above Goa. Beach entry is free, beach hours 05:00-18:00, and the jet ski counter runs roughly 10:00-17:00 — 16:12 is well inside it.
events.tips: The '15:00 closing' scare was a false alarm: that figure came from a tour-package box, not the counter hours. Book at the beach desk, and stash bags in a locker while you ride.

events.title: SUNSET @ Laxmanpur Beach 1
events.notes: Sunset is 17:14 (verified), so you are settled well before it goes. Dead-coral shore - watch rather than swim.

events.title: Ride to dinner
events.notes: Pure Veg sits on the Lakshmanpur side, minutes from the sunset beach.

events.title: Dinner @ Pure Veg Restaurant
events.cost_note: thali Rs 240 pp plus extras
events.notes: Neil's best-rated veg kitchen, 4.8 stars from 254 reviews.

events.title: Ride to Blue Lagoon & check in
events.cost_note: stay Rs 3,968 (breakfast incl., free cancellation) + Rs 150 fuel — RE-PRICING LIVE for Sep 24-25
events.notes: Refuel at IndianOil Neil Kendra on the way if it is still open - it is the island's only pump.
events.tips: Tomorrow starts at 04:30 for the Sitapur sunrise, so unpack only what you need.

events.title: Wind down
events.tips: Tomorrow: Sitapur sunrise, then Natural Bridge at the 08:51 low tide.

days.title: PINK DAWN → CLIFF RUN
days.theme: Sitapur sunrise, Natural Bridge at a 0.4 m low tide, ferry west, Munda Pahad trek, Chidiya Tapu sunset.

events.title: SUNRISE @ Sitapur Beach + cave & shipwreck
events.notes: Sunrise 05:09, pink-tinged sand. Walk ~500 m along the shore for the photo-frame cave and the shipwreck.

events.title: NATURAL BRIDGE at low tide
events.notes: Low tide 08:51 at 0.40 m (verified) — the full walk to and past the coral arch is open. Tide pools hold trapped fish.
events.tips: Grip water-shoes mandatory; dead coral is slippery. Optional guide Rs 500/group.

events.title: Green Ocean check-in
events.notes: Counter opens 60 min before sailing and shuts 15 min prior. PRINTED ticket mandatory.

events.title: SAIL — Green Ocean 1 to Port Blair
events.cost_note: 3 x Rs 1,400 all-in (Green Ocean 1, Rs 1,050 + Rs 50 PMB + Rs 300 fuel)
events.notes: Rs 2,325 cheaper than the Makruzz sailing. Lands 12:45 instead of 12:30, which still leaves a 35-minute margin on the Munda Pahad gate.

events.title: PB scooters near jetty + snack grab
events.cost_note: 2 x ~Rs 600/day (Eternal Andamans; Rs 500 refundable deposit each)
events.notes: Eternal currently rents at Port Blair only — confirmed live. Grab bananas/snacks; lunch is light today.

events.title: Ride south to Chidiya Tapu
events.cost_note: ~2.7 L fuel for the 55 km round trip
events.notes: 24 km, 44 min on NH4 — South Andaman's prettiest road.

events.title: MUNDA PAHAD TREK
events.notes: Gate entry must be BEFORE 15:00 (we arrive 14:10, a 50-minute margin). The trail is about 1.5 km one way and takes 30-60 minutes depending on pace, on an uneven path with a few inclines. Entry is free; be back down by 16:15-16:30 when the area clears.
events.tips: Trainers, water and mosquito repellent. Budget 2-2.5 hours for the round trip including time at the top.

events.title: Munda Pahad beach + ride back to Chidiya Tapu
SUNSET @ Chidiya Tapu
events.notes: The best sunset stage in South Andaman (sunset 17:14). NO swimming — saltwater crocodiles are spotted here.
events.tips: Parking area is a short walk from the beach through tall trees.

events.title: Night ride back to Port Blair
Check in @ Pibo Homestay
events.cost_note: Family Room for 3 (1 full + 1 king), 2 nights, breakfast incl., free cancellation to 24 Sep — live Booking.com quote 20 Aug
events.notes: 9.3/10 from 138 reviews. Rs 875 per person per night — Rs 3,595 cheaper than Hotel Atlanta, which scores 7.9, charges extra for breakfast and has no sea view despite the name.
events.tips: Only 1 room left at this rate — book it before the flights if you want it.

events.title: Dinner @ Annapurna Cafeteria
events.notes: Veg South-Indian stalwart, 200 m from the hotel.

events.title: Prep for Baratang + wind down
events.tips: Reconfirm the 04:00 cab, pack water/snacks/ID, keep cameras packed away for the convoy.

days.title: JARAWA CONVOY → LIMESTONE
days.theme: The 4 AM mission: convoy through the reserve, mangrove speedboat, million-year cave — then an earned nap and the Marina at dusk.

events.title: Cab to Jirkatang Check Post
events.cost_note: 3 x Rs 2,250 shared joining tour (Andaman Ocean) — includes A/C shared cab with hotel pickup, convoy permit assistance, shared speedboat tickets, tolls and parking
events.notes: A shared vehicle rather than your own car: Rs 1,350 cheaper and it folds the speedboat and permits into one price. Hotel pickup around 04:00 to make the 06:00 convoy.
events.tips: Excludes the Rs 14 pp vehicle-ferry ticket and all meals. A private sedan is Rs 5,400 + boat if you would rather not share.

events.title: CONVOY through the Jarawa reserve
events.notes: 48 km escorted. Absolutely no photography, no stopping, windows up if asked.
events.tips: You may glimpse Jarawa people — cameras stay down, it is a criminal offence.

events.title: Vehicle ferry across Middle Strait
events.notes: Fee included in cab tour.

events.title: Speedboat into the mangroves
events.cost_note: included in the shared tour price
events.notes: A 6-8 seat motorboat, about 25 minutes each way through mangrove creeks. Half the show is the ride.

events.title: LIMESTONE CAVES
events.notes: 1.2 km walk from the drop point, then ~35 min inside the sculpted chambers.
events.tips: Headlamp beats phone torch; floor is wet and uneven.

events.title: Early lunch @ Baratang jetty
events.notes: Simple veg meals only — eat now, the convoy won't stop.

events.title: Ferry back across the strait
events.notes: Vehicle ferry across Middle Strait — included in the private-cab rate.

events.title: Return convoy (12:30 slot)
events.notes: Southbound convoys leave the Baratang side at roughly 12:00, 15:00 and 16:00 — the LAST one is 15:00 and missing it strands you overnight. Your driver knows the day's slot; confirm it on arrival.

events.title: Earned nap
events.notes: Protects the sleep average after the 03:30 start.

events.title: Marina Park + Flag Point at dusk
events.notes: Where the first tricolour rose in 1943; the waterfront is 5 min from the hotel.

events.title: Optional: Cellular Jail light & sound (Hindi)
events.notes: On Saturday every show is in HINDI: 17:50, 18:50 and 19:50. English runs only Mon/Wed/Fri, so there is no English option on the 26th. The 17:50 Hindi show fits this slot.
events.cost_note: Rs 300 per adult (Rs 900 for three) if you go — not counted in the trip budget
events.tips: Tickets are sold on the official Andaman Tourism e-Tourist portal. Skip it freely if the 04:00 start has flattened everyone — nothing downstream depends on it.

days.title: EXFIL
days.theme: Slow morning, 10:35 wheels-up, Chennai by lunch.

events.title: Breakfast + pack out
events.notes: Breakfast is included here, so no need to hunt for an early cafe before the airport run.
events.cost_note: breakfast included at Pibo

events.title: Cab to the airport
events.notes: 2.7 km against traffic — 10 min.

events.title: Check-in + security
events.notes: Akasa counter closes 09:50 — we're in with 1h45 to spare.

events.title: FLY — Akasa QP 1146 to Chennai
events.cost_note: 3 x Rs 9,206 (Cleartrip 3-adult, 19 Aug)
events.notes: 2h20m home. Right-side windows for a last look at the archipelago.

events.title: Land MAA — trip complete
events.notes: Every minute since Wednesday 03:45 is on this map.
